relationships.subject: neonatal maternal separation
relationships.evidence_quote: NMS animals displayed a long-lasting upregulation of chloride importer Na-K-Cl cotransporter type 1 (NKCC1) expression in the cerebrum and spinal cord

relationships.subject: bumetanide
relationships.evidence_quote: Neonatal administration of the NKCC1 inhibitor bumetanide or oxytocin successfully normalized the anxiety-like symptoms and the lack of social preference observed in NMS animals

relationships.subject: oxytocin
relationships.evidence_quote: Neonatal administration of the NKCC1 inhibitor bumetanide or oxytocin successfully normalized the anxiety-like symptoms and the lack of social preference observed in NMS animals

relationships.subject: neuro-inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: Phenotypic alterations were associated with a pro-inflammatory state which could contribute to NKCC1 upregulation

key_findings: Neonatal maternal separation causes long-lasting NKCC1 upregulation in rat cerebrum and spinal cord.
Neonatal bumetanide or oxytocin normalized anxiety-like behavior and social preference deficits in NMS rats.
